Terms, refunds, privacy and contact

Effective October 17, 2026. Home Base is built by its founders, Christopher Brouard and Elizabeth Garcia, in Baltimore, Maryland. Paid plans are sold and billed by Infinite Legacies LLC, so that name may appear on your card statement.

Cancellation and refunds

  • Cancel anytime in the app: Profile → Home Base Plans → Manage subscription. You keep your paid features until the end of the month you already paid for, then you move to Free. Your records stay yours.
  • No charge after you cancel. We do not charge cancellation fees.
  • Refunds. If you were charged by mistake, charged twice, or a paid feature did not work and we could not fix it, email us within 30 days of the charge and we will refund it. We may also refund a first monthly charge if you ask within 7 days and used few GPT Live minutes. Otherwise monthly charges are not refunded for partial months.
  • Minute packs are refundable within 7 days if none of the extra minutes were used.
  • Refunds go back to the original payment method. Banks usually post them within 5–10 business days.

Terms of service

  1. Who can use it. You must be 18 or older. You are responsible for your account and for keeping your sign-in secure.
  2. Driving safety. Use the screens only while parked. Voice features are for hands-free use where the law allows. Always follow traffic laws and your rideshare platform's rules.
  3. Estimates, not guarantees. Demand maps, routes, forecasts, AI answers and earnings figures are estimates that can be wrong. Home Base does not guarantee demand, rides, income or results. Check important numbers yourself.
  4. Not affiliated. Home Base is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Uber, Lyft, Empower or any other platform. We never ask for your platform passwords.
  5. AI features. Paid AI features are provided through third-party AI services and depend on their availability. Monthly GPT Live minutes are limits, not guarantees of uptime.
  6. Acceptable use. Do not misuse the service, try to access other people's data, upload others' personal information without permission, or interfere with the app.
  7. Changes. We may change features or prices. Price changes apply from your next billing period, and we will tell you in the app before they do.
  8. Ending service. You can stop using Home Base and delete your account at any time in the app. We may suspend accounts that break these terms.
  9. Liability. To the extent the law allows, Home Base is provided "as is", and our total liability for any claim is limited to the amount you paid us in the 3 months before the claim.
  10. Law. These terms are governed by the laws of Maryland, USA.

Privacy

  • What we keep: your account email, the earnings records and settings you save, and your plan and minutes used. Payment details are held by Stripe.
  • Location: used on your device to show demand near you. Optional study sharing stores neighborhood names, not precise GPS, and is off unless you turn it on.
  • AI: when you use GPT features, your question and the context needed to answer it are sent to our AI provider to produce the answer. Free built-in AI runs on your phone.
  • Your control: view, export, clear cloud data or delete your account in Profile → Privacy. Optional data sharing can be withdrawn at any time.
  • We do not sell your personal information or your earnings records.
